[[File:Muur_Talisman.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Muur Talisman]], a powerful Sith artifact]]
'''Dark side artifacts''' were ancient weapons and tools used by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and other organizations dedicated to the use of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. They were used to enhance and/or assist the user's ability to channel [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to attain their desired goals.
